newsitem.title: USA: Presstek enters "conditional settlement" with SEC.
newsitem.headline: Presstek enters "conditional settlement" with SEC.

text.p: Presstek Inc said on Tuesday it has reached a proposed agreement in principle with the staff of the U.S. Securities and Exchange Commission which could bring a close to its involvement in the SEC's investigation into trading of the company's stock.

The company said the settlement calls for the consensual entry of a cease and desist order in which the company, without admitting or denying violations of the securities laws, agrees to abide by federal securities laws and regulations in the future.
The allegations by the SEC giving rise to this matter relate to the accuracy of certain disclosures made by Presstek at various times from 1994 to 1996.

The terms of agreement must be presented to the SEC by its staff and are subject to a detailed review by senior staff and SEC officers prior to approval by the SEC. Such approval is not automatic or guaranteed.

In related matters, the company also announced that other agreements in principle had been reached between Robert Howard, the company's chairman, and the SEC; and between Robert Verrando, the company's president, and the SEC. These agreements are also subject to further review and approval.
Presstek offers proprietary nonphotographic, digital imaging and printing plate technology for the printing and graphic arts industries.
